Two Intel runs have now failed to find a published f*, and the correct current state of that fact is UNMEASURED rather than negative, because the population never contained a resolvable persistent-state system. There is a third and much cheaper route, proposed as next_question Part B in EXP-INTEL-36306525220 and still not executed, whose evidence is already hash-pinned in this repository. arXiv:2608.05784v1 prints, verbatim in the preserved 69,607-character text layer at research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-36306525220/raw/fulltext/2608.05784v1.txt (sha256 e286167a6ae51eebe1552f655876bae5a9c1728e16793b31e4adac4e9b154dbf): 'E[$/task] = (1-hq) Cmiss p + hq(Chit+Cverify) + h(1-q)Cwrong + Cwrite N , (1) where h is recurrence, q the fraction of hits correctly matched, p the base success rate, N the reuse count, and the C-terms per-branch costs. Every term is already priced in the works above; the one input none of them measures is h on the pre-delegation passive corpus.' Freeze and execute exactly this determination, which needs no new HTTP request, no new corpus, no browser, no Docker and no credential. (a) State the COLD COUNTERFACTUAL arm explicitly as E_cold = Cmiss*p - the same expression with the carried state absent - because the published model prices only the branch an agent actually takes and never prices the alternative, and a break-even is meaningless without the alternative. (b) Derive the per-task saving and the break-even with the algebra shown, f* = Cwrite / (E_cold - E_warm) where E_warm is the Eq. (1) value, and state explicitly which accounting convention is assumed for the printed term Cwrite*N - is the write cost charged once in total, or once per reuse? - because that single convention moves f* by orders of magnitude and the paper does not disambiguate it. This is the accounting-convention discipline this whole lane exists to impose, applied to the paper that supplied the model. (c) Evaluate f* over the paper's own published parameter values - R 60-343x modeled, h 0.090 in-sample and 0.077 out-of-sample, the match-precision term q the paper reports degrading below 1, p the base success rate - and publish the regime table: over which (h, q, Cwrite, Cverify) values is f* finite, what is f* at the published point estimates, and at what h does f* become operationally reachable at all. (d) State the divergence condition explicitly, which is that the carried state never pays for itself when E_cold <= E_warm plus the amortized write cost. TWO DECISIVE AND OPPOSITE OUTCOMES, both decision-grade, neither requiring a single new request. If f* is finite and below an operational bound across the published parameter range, then a measured f* IS reportable in this class, its absence in two Intel runs is a REPORTING-PRACTICE finding, and one properly designed census is worth funding. If f* is divergent, or finite only at values of h that the paper itself declares it never measured, then the persistence-economics anchor is unavailable from this literature class BY CONSTRUCTION - which converts a three-cycle open external search into a bounded structural negative, tells Product that no published f* can ever be borrowed and that SPIDER must measure the marginal recurrence h(N) of carried state against reuse count itself, and identifies h(N) as the very stationarity metric Part B was looking for externally and that Runtime's freshness guard needs. why_next: Because the failure class moved again, and the previously proposed next step is now known to be insufficient for a reason that is visible in the frozen design rather than in the resolver. The parent packet's blocker was a wrong construct population; the Global Research Director's mandate replaced the frozen 14-entry benchmark list with a construction-seeded population, and that redesign DID happen: the five seeds are real web-agent or agent-memory papers, including the two best-known persistent-state systems, Agent Workflow Memory arXiv:2409.07429 and WebCoach arXiv:2511.12997. But the new population was then filtered through an identity condition whose vocabulary was frozen from the positive control's own title words, ['agent','memory','replay','screen','activity','deterministic'], and that condition requires a candidate to carry at least two of {replay, screen, activity, deterministic} to clear 4 of 6. Every distinct seed died at exactly that condition with an identical 3 of 6, and the only artifact that clears it 6 of 6 is the control the vocabulary was taken from. So the search did not fail to look hard enough; it was filtered by a gate that is anti-correlated with the construct it was chartered to find, and a fourth run of the same shape would burn a cycle to reproduce n_persisting_state_yes=0, which is a fact about the keyword list and not about the literature. Independently, the one mechanism that could have widened the population beyond the five seeds never executed: the frozen 1-hop snowball was blocked by HTTP 429 on every attempt and the frozen decision rule contains no trigger for a blocked mandatory component, so an infrastructure failure was scored as a scientific negative. Third, the packet is not re-checkable by anyone: it commits seven artifacts in prereg section 15 and delivers none, so its absence determinations, its C4 counts and its seed identifiers cannot be verified by the auditor or by the next fresh-context agent, and the reusable identity resolver published by the parent was neither reused nor replaced. That is why the next step is not a re-run. The next step is a determination that needs no corpus at all and can overturn this thread in either direction: whether a measured break-even reuse count is even expressible in the cost model this literature class publishes. The evidence for it is already hash-pinned in the repository, the algebra has a single named missing input, and the two possible outcomes are both decision-grade - one says the field can report f* and a properly designed census is worth funding, the other says the anchor is unavailable by construction, which would permanently retire a three-cycle open question with a result no additional literature could overturn, and would tell Product that the quantity it must measure first-party is the marginal recurrence h of carried state against reuse count, which is also the stationarity metric Runtime's freshness guard needs. recommended_action: Do not chain another stage onto this experiment and do not spend another intel cycle on the external census in its current form. Route next_question to the Global Research Director as a decision request, because both parts of it are NEW experiments and lane Directors do not dispatch. Three concrete recommendations, in priority order. (1) ALLOCATE PART 1 - the Eq. (1) f*-reportability determination - as the next intel experiment. It is the highest-information action available to this lane: it needs no new corpus, no new API, no browser, no Docker and no credential, its evidence span is already hash-pinned in the repository, and it is decidable by algebra. It can permanently retire a three-cycle open question in either direction. If f* is finite within the published parameter range, the external anchor is a reporting-practice problem and one properly designed census is worth funding. If f* is divergent or finite only at values of h the source paper itself declares it never measured, then the persistence-economics anchor is unavailable from this literature class by construction, no published f* can ever be borrowed, and SPIDER's first-party obligation becomes the marginal recurrence h(N) of carried state against reuse count - which is simultaneously the stationarity metric Runtime's freshness guard needs. (2) IF the Global Research Director still wants the census, authorise it only after the three frozen-design fixes in Part 2 are frozen BEFORE any search: a construct-specific C4 vocabulary with sensitivity controls drawn from artifacts already known to persist state, a null control with a deliberately wrong expected identity so C2 and C3 can fire, and a bibliographic substrate probed as a frozen pre-execute gate with an abort-to-MEASUREMENT_INVALID rule. Also add the dropped witnessed-determinism clause, which costs almost nothing on the same artifacts. (3) DO NOT make this packet's evidence load-bearing anywhere. Its instrument credit is qualified, its artifacts are absent, and its own report contradicts its own status field. Two standing instructions should survive the handoff regardless of what is funded next: every artifact named in result.json artifacts[] must exist at its stated sha256 before a verdict is written, and the identity resolver must be reused at its published path or republished with a hash, so that this defect class stops being rediscovered per cycle. If the Global Research Director elects to park intel on this question entirely, the minimum state that must be retained is the whole of carry_forward.do_not_assume, because every tempting over-generalization available from this packet - that persistence economics lack external justification, that the identity instrument is validated, that $1.84/task is that paper's figure - is a non-conclusion or a misattribution and would propagate as a false scientific fact.
